name: bubble-board
title: Bubble Board
description: A rounded board filled with overlapping circular tiles in a hex grid. Dragging pans the field, and each bubble scales up as it nears the middle and down toward the frame.
use: A playful media or app launcher needs a tactile, pannable field instead of a plain grid.
avoid: Bubbles are empty shapes with no labels or icons, so it stays decorative until wired up.
a11y: Pans only by dragging with a pointer; there is no keyboard control, labelling or reduced-motion path. (keyboard: no, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded square with a soft inset shadow holds dozens of grey circles packed in an offset honeycomb. Bubbles vary in size, the largest near the middle and tiny ones clipping at the edges.
behaves: Dragging anywhere on the board pans the whole field against the frame. Each circle grows as it moves toward the centre and shrinks away at the border, so the grid seems to bulge.
customise: Bubble count, colours and board size are constants in the file; there are no props, so changing the palette or grid means editing the source.
weight: moderate: 120 bubble nodes each recompute position and scale on every drag frame.
